F1: getGroupIdsWithViewPermission` passes and collects `groupResource.getId()` (a resource UUID, not a group ID), so the per-group `findByName` lookup misses and the returned set never holds real group IDs; user counts and group-filtered search come out wrong.
F2: canManage()` checks `hasPermission(null, VIEW, MANAGE)`, so an all-groups VIEW grant passes `requireManage()` in `addTopLevelGroup` and a view-only admin can create top-level groups.
F3: canView()` only looks at the all-groups resource, so VIEW on a single group does not pass `requireList()`; callers who do pass can already view every group, so realm-wide counts reveal nothing new.
